purpose: Screen-scope observation leg (Rev19 §19.2): one read-only screen capture taken before the single authorized input, accepted only if the frozen locator returns ELIGIBLE on a crop of the AX window bounds at scale 2 or scale 1.

probe.sound: none (-x: silent, no cursor drawn, no window highlight)

window_localization.method: alignment of the 2x-upscaled AX-window frame (/tmp/route_frame_pre.jpg, 327x643 from line.getScreenshot) against the probe by a mean-absolute-difference search over the window origin; independently re-run after the input (read-only, no GUI input, no new capture)

notes: screencapture -x is read-only: it sends no input event, produces no sound, and neither raises nor activates any window.
The crop rectangles were derived from the AX window bounds of 標準視窗 (jp.naver.line.mac) at the offsets recorded above; the crops are analysis derivatives of the same probe (no additional capture).
Frame and crop bytes are never committed (attempt-03 policy); only bytes/size/SHA-256 are recorded and the files stay in /tmp so Stage 05 can re-run the frozen tools on them.
